action_args.comment_content: The distinction between FAST and MEPS+ protocols is fundamental to Singapore's payment architecture. While FAST facilitates near-instantaneous retail transfers, MEPS+ serves as the Real-Time Gross Settlement (RTGS) system for high-value interbank transactions. Adherence to MAS clearing windows is a requirement for managing intra-day liquidity and ensuring the finality of settlement. Participants must ensure that payment instructions are submitted within the prescribed windows to avoid carry-over risks and to maintain compliance with the Clearing House Rules. Technical precision in these transfers is non-negotiable for systemic stability.
